_meta.scraper: manual browser scrape via claude-in-chrome (Agent A, GATE 1 - no migration written)
_meta.notes: All prices in GBP as displayed on Acuity (e.g. 220.00 = £220.00). duration_mins is the parsed total minutes from the displayed duration string. 'hair_included' true means the Acuity listing itself states hair/bundles are included in the price (usually the 'Hair Included Styles' category or Miracle Knots hair-included variants); false/omitted means the client supplies their own hair/packs. Every 'SHOW ALL' truncation on Braids and Touch-Ups categories was expanded before capture so notes are verbatim and complete.
